# 📄 contributing

# Panduan Kontribusi

Terima kasih sudah berkontribusi di Griya Taman Belibis!

## Quick Start

```bash
# 1. Fork & Clone
git clone https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/bydara-jaya-develindo.git

# 2. Install
npm install

# 3. Buat Branch
git checkout -b fitur/nama-fitur

# 4. Jalankan
npm run dev

# 5. Commit & Push
git commit -m "feat: deskripsi"
git push origin fitur/nama-fitur

# 6. Buka PR
```

## Commit Convention

| Type | Deskripsi |
|------|-----------|
| `feat:` | Fitur baru |
| `fix:` | Perbaikan bug |
| `docs:` | Dokumentasi |
| `style:` | Style (tidak ubah logic) |
| `refactor:` | Refactoring |
| `test:` | Test |
| `chore:` | Maintenance |

## Branch Naming

```
fitur/dark-mode
fix/form-validasi
docs/update-readme
style/card-design
```

## Code Style

- TypeScript strict mode
- Functional components
- Tailwind CSS dengan cn() helper
- Named export (bukan default)
- File: kebab-case
- Component: PascalCase

## PR Process

1. Sync dengan upstream
2. Buat branch baru
3. Buat perubahan
4. Jalankan `npm run lint`
5. Push & buka PR
6. Isi template PR
7. Tunggu review
